summary.intent: Capture implementation decisions for Phase 21 (BYO-IPFS Node Support) via discuss-phase, then generate research, validation strategy, UI-SPEC, and planning artifacts.
summary.outcome: CONTEXT.md, RESEARCH.md, VALIDATION.md, and UI-SPEC.md were all created for Phase 21. The UI-SPEC required a manual spacing fix after two automated revision rounds failed to resolve a Dimension 5 badge padding issue.

repo: BYO-IPFS pinning model was revised from always-dual (server-relay) to three user-selectable modes: CipherBox only / External only / Dual-pin, with client-direct architecture instead of server relay.
Auth token security model is zero-knowledge: credentials stored encrypted in vault metadata on IPFS, decrypted client-side only — CipherBox API never sees plaintext tokens.
Pin migration uses TEE (Phala Cloud) as background job: client provides CID list + encrypted source/dest configs, TEE decrypts in-enclave, migrates opaque encrypted blobs without seeing content.
ROADMAP.md SC#2 and BYO-02 success criteria are now stale — they reflect the old server-relay dual-pin model, not the revised three-mode + client-direct architecture.
Provider compatibility supports both PSA (IPFS Pinning Service API) and Kubo RPC, auto-detected during connection test; CORS validated as part of that test.
TEE infrastructure (Phala Cloud, BullMQ job queue, key epoch rotation) is already in place and was designed to handle background jobs like IPNS republishing — pin migration reuses the same pattern.

code.finding: Existing IpfsProvider interface is the extension point for adding a RemotePinningProvider SDK layer.
Local IPFS provider implementation — reference pattern for new external provider.
Existing Settings page — Phase 21 adds a new STORAGE tab here with save/discard pattern and inline connection test.
PinnedCid entity will need extension or a related entity to track BYO pinning status and migration progress per CID.
ADVISORY badge had non-4px-grid padding (2px 6px) that blocked UI checker Dimension 5; required manual fix after two automated revision rounds failed.

workflow: UI-SPEC revision loop (max 2 iterations) can fail to fix specific pixel-level issues that require targeted grep + manual Edit rather than re-spawning the full researcher agent.
The discuss-phase workflow correctly identified a fundamental architecture change (server-relay → client-direct) mid-session and captured it before locking decisions.
TEE-based background jobs are a reusable pattern in this repo — when a background task needs auth credentials but not plaintext content, TEE is the preferred approach.

friction: UI checker blocked on ADVISORY badge padding (2px 6px violates 4px grid) after two full researcher revision rounds — had to manually grep and edit the spec.
plan-phase was interrupted mid-flow to run ui-phase first due to missing UI-SPEC, requiring a context break and re-invocation.
ROADMAP.md success criteria (SC#2, BYO-02) are now stale after the pinning model architecture change — not updated during this session.
